Every Athanor, Hellfire Forge, Tabula Vitae and Sanguine Crafter in a [#](8B0000)27-wide[#]() area works [#](8B0000)ten times[#]() as fast, on top of anything else that hastens it.
Give a ritual a new center.

The crystal stays dark until a linked ritual is running. It then pulses in the color of the Spiritus its rituals draw, or blood red when they draw none or more than one kind.\
\
Look at the anchor while carrying a [#](8B0000)Seer's Sigil[#]() to see the areas of every ritual linked to it.

A ritual works around its [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](), which makes it hard to fit several circles around one spot. The [#](8B0000)Ritual Anchor[#]() lends a ritual a new center.\
\
Right-click the anchor with a [#](8B0000)Ritual Configurator[#](), then right-click a Master Ritual Stone within 64 blocks. From then on the ritual works around the anchor instead: its areas, the Spiritus it draws, and the streams it sends all start from the crystal.
Ritual Anchor

Any number of stones can share one anchor, so you can build the circles out of the way and stack their effects on a single room.\
\
Repeat the link with the same anchor to unlink a stone. A redstone signal on the anchor pauses every ritual linked to it, while a signal on one stone pauses only that ritual.\
\
[#](2E8B57)If the anchor is broken, its rituals stop. Dungeon rituals cannot use an anchor.[#]()
Quickens the machines of the art.

Every [#](8B0000)Athanor[#](), [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#](), [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() and [#](8B0000)Sanguine Crafter[#]() within the circle works at [#](8B0000)twice[#]() its usual pace. This adds to whatever already hastens the machine, such as an Athanor's tool or a rich Aura.\
\
A craft costs no more than it would without the ritual. The ritual itself draws [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() each second for every machine that is working; idle machines cost nothing.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Its Deus form works ten times as fast.[#]()
The Quickened Hearth
Ritual of Celerity

A [#](8B0000)Hellforged Block[#]() steeped in [#](8B0000)10,000 mB of Essentia Vitae[#]() and [#](4A0080)40 of every Spiritus[#]() becomes a [#](8B0000)Sanguine Deus Block[#](). The [#](8B0000)Divinus Orb of Vitae[#]() guides the work from the tool slot.\
\
Beneath the Endless Quarry it gives the widest reach of any foundation, and it serves as a beacon base.
Sanguine Deus Block

Every slot of the Forge, the gem slot included, can be opened to any side for hoppers and pipes. Click an empty slot, then toggle the side buttons that appear: green sides reach that slot, red sides do not. By default each ingredient slot takes its own side, the gem the top, and the output the bottom. With the output slot chosen, right-click a side to push finished items out of it.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The Sanguine Crafter can also work Forge recipes, many at a time.[#]()
Automating the Forge

While whole and running, the crafter keeps the chunks it stands in loaded so your work goes on when you wander off. By default this lasts only while its builder is online, and each player may keep ten crafters working this way. Server owners may change or disable this.
A Workshop That Never Sleeps

The redstone button sets whether a signal on the crafter starts or stops it. The [#](8B0000)limit[#]() halts crafting while the output buffer holds that many of the result; scroll over it to change it.\
\
Hover over the arrow or the status line to see why the crafter waits, how many crafts it runs at once and whether it keeps its chunks loaded.

Each craft draws a little [#](4A0080)EV[#]() from the network of whoever built the crafter.\
\
Tabula Vitae recipes need a bound [#](8B0000)Blood Orb[#]() of their tier in the orb slot, and that orb's network pays the recipe's EV. Hellfire Forge recipes draw on the [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() in the gem slot, which drinks from the local Aura like the forge's own.
Paying the Price
A workshop that crafts while you are away.

Ingredients go into the [#](8B0000)input buffer[#]() in any order, and results gather in the [#](8B0000)output buffer[#](). Every casing and the crafter itself accept hoppers, pipes and [#](4A0080)Routing Nodes[#]().\
\
Click an empty slot to choose which sides reach its group. With the output buffer chosen, right-click a side to push results out of it into whatever waits there.
Feeding the Crafter

The [#](8B0000)Sanguine Crafter[#]() is a tireless workshop of stone and blood. It works [#](8B0000)crafting table[#](), [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() and [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() recipes without the station beside it, pulling ingredients from a buffer you can fill by any means.\
\
Every recipe still pays its true price: the orb, the gem and the Essentia Vitae its own station would ask.
Sanguine Crafter

The crafter serves an AE2 pattern provider or Refined Storage autocrafter like any machine. Leave it in [#](8B0000)Auto[#]() so one crafter takes every pattern, keep the fuel slots off the provider's side, and push results back out of that side.\
\
Turn on the provider's [#](8B0000)blocking mode[#](): two recipes pushed at once would stall it.
Storage Networks

A 3x3 floor of [#](8B0000)Sanguine Casing[#]() with a ring of casings on top, and the [#](8B0000)Sanguine Crafter[#]() in the middle of one side of the ring, facing out. The block in the center, right behind the crafter, can be anything, so a pipe can reach in. Once whole, the casings join into one shell.
The Workshop

The grid on the left of the crafter's menu is a [#](8B0000)template[#](). Click items into it, or press the [#](8B0000)+[#]() button on a recipe in JEI, and the crafter learns that recipe. The mode button chooses whether the template is read as a crafting table, Tabula Vitae or Hellfire Forge recipe.\
\
[#](8B0000)Auto[#]() mode needs no template: it crafts whichever Tabula Vitae or Hellfire Forge recipe the input buffer holds exactly.
The Template

Any casing may be swapped for an upgraded one.\
\
Each [#](8B0000)Hellforged Sanguine Casing[#]() lets the crafter finish one more craft at a time, up to sixteen by default. Each [#](8B0000)Swift Sanguine Casing[#]() makes every craft 25%% faster by default.
Quickening the Workshop

Jab with it, or hold it ready and charge, mounted or on foot. Its damage, its Aspect effects and the Spiritus it reaps from the slain grow with your reserves, just as the sword's do.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Forge it from an Iron Spear and a Petty Spiritus Gem in the Hellfire Forge.[#]()
Sentient Spear
The [#](8B0000)Sentient Spear[#]() is the hunter's answer to the sword. Every jab and every charge falls just short of a [#](8B0000)Netherite Spear[#](), before the Spiritus you carry is counted.
Snares hostile creatures so they give up Spiritus Essence when slain.

The [#](8B0000)Soul Snare[#]() elixir binds a hostile creature's spirit to its body. If a snared monster dies by your hand, or soon after you have struck it, its spirit is torn free as [#](4A0080)Spiritus Essence[#](), more from creatures with greater health.\
\
Thrown as a splash or lingering flask, it snares a whole group at once, which you may then cut down with any weapon.\
\
[#](2E8B57)A monster that dies without you, to a trap or a fall, gives up nothing.[#]()
